title: An agent's open questions are answered at the top of the ticket, in its state card; the report below points up to them

steps.click: .backlog-item:has-text("Pin a ticket to the top of the backlog")

steps.waitFor: h1:has-text("Pin a ticket to the top of the backlog")

steps.caption: Right under the title, the state card asks the agent's open question: what it needs, and the mockups to pick
The report in the Activity lists the question without a second form, and points up: Answer at the top
You pick B in the card and Send
Answered: the report shows the answer as before, with no form
And the top, under the title, shows the ticket's state again: no question left to answer there
